description: Bank of daily missions — every mission happens off-screen, and its estimated time is never less than five times the card's minutes (the card is three minutes, so the floor is fifteen).

missions.instruction_ar: Go out to the balcony or the yard and look for five things that are green, then come back and tell your dad or mom.
Set the table by yourself today, and say «بسم الله» before you all eat.
Call your grandpa or grandma and ask how they're doing, then tell them something that happened to you today.

missions.title_ar: Something Alive Is Counting on You
missions.instruction_ar: Water a plant at home or at a neighbor's, and check on it every day for a week.

missions.title_ar: A Good Deed Nobody Knows About
missions.instruction_ar: Do something kind for someone at home without telling them and without telling anyone else, and tell only your dad that you did it.
Sit and look at the sky for ten minutes, then draw what you saw and tell your dad about it.
Tidy your shelf or your drawer by yourself, and take out one thing you don't use anymore and give it to someone.
Ask your dad or mom: "What's the hardest thing you ever did when you were little?" Then listen all the way to the end of the story without interrupting.
Go out for a walk with someone from home, and count how many trees the two of you saw along the way.
Think of someone you made sad without meaning to, then go and say "I'm sorry" while looking them in the eye.
Memorize a short verse of the Qur'an with your dad or mom, and say it back to them before bed without looking.

missions.title_ar: Build Something With Your Own Hands
missions.instruction_ar: Build anything out of the cardboard boxes or the blocks you have, then show it to someone at home and explain how you made it.
